en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small river port with sailing boats moored along the bank in front of a row of traditional stone and timber houses with tiled roofs and wooden balconies. The waterfront has arcades and small storage structures. Rolling hills rise behind the town. Printed captions in Spanish/Galician identify the view as the pier of Betanzos and give the publisher's address in La Coruña.
